name: lib_monotone_sum_range_le_mul
statement: (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (a : ℕ → R) (ha : Monotone a) (n : ℕ) : ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i ≤ (n : R) * a n
closed: ∀ (R : Type*) [CommRing R] [LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (a : ℕ → R) (ha : Monotone a) (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i ≤ (n : R) * a n
informal: For a monotone sequence in a linearly ordered commutative ring, the sum of the first n terms is at most n * a n. Promoted from Mathlib2.gen_an_chebyshev_index_weighted_ordered_ring_aux1 (also proved over ℝ as an2_chebyshev_index_weighted_aux1).
type: ∀ (R : Type u_1) [inst : CommRing R] [inst_1 : LinearOrder R] [IsStrictOrderedRing R] (a : ℕ → R), Monotone a → ∀ (n : ℕ), ∑ i ∈ Finset.range n, a i ≤ ↑n * a n
